shortDescription: Use webhooks to create Connector Card messages within an Office 365 group

options.name: actions
options.description: This array of objects is used to power the action links found at the bottom of the card.

options.name: color
options.description: Accent color used for branding or indicating status in the card.

options.name: sections
options.description: Contains a list of sections to display in the card. For more information see U(https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/actionable-messages/message-card-reference#section-fields).

options.name: summary
options.description: A string used for summarizing card content. This is the message subject. This is required if the text parameter is not populated.

options.name: text
options.description: The main text of the card. This is rendered below the sender information and optional title, And above any sections or actions present.

options.name: title
options.description: A title for the Connector message. Shown at the top of the message.

options.name: webhook
options.description: The webhook URL is given to you when you create a new Connector.
